summary: Materialise NV (Nasdaq: MTLS, Euronext: MTLS) filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly progress under its existing share buyback program announced on 30 October 2025. The company repurchased 50,627 shares from 18-22 May 2026 at a weighted average price of EUR 4.85 per share (total consideration EUR 245,759). Since launch on 26 January 2026, 799,416 shares have been bought back (EUR 3.65M, 1.4% of outstanding). The program has a EUR 30 million maximum. This is an ordinary buyback execution update, not a new special-situation event.
